name: canopy
description: Your project's file tree beside the chat, lit by what Claude reads, edits and commits.

start.title: Open at start
start.description: on: open the tree when a session starts (if the terminal is wide enough). off: open it with /canopy.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Which of Claude's file activity lights the tree.

ignore.title: Also ignore
ignore.description: Comma-separated names to hide, on top of .gitignore and the built-ins (node_modules, dist…).

follow.title: Follow
follow.description: Scroll to the file Claude is touching.
